A [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species''' had [[Color|yellow]] skin and black [[eye]]s. The [[species]] had round faces, large chins, and a lack of visible nostrils. [[Unidentified casino gambler|One]] [[Gender|female]] member of the species<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" /> was active by [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|2|9}}</ref> often frequenting the establishment [[Vranki's Hotel and Casino]] as a patron.<ref name="Bucket's List Voxx Vortex">{{BucketsList|nUJM3Gn2mfg|"The Voxx Vortex 5000"}}</ref> That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|2|9}}</ref> the elderly woman played a game at one of the [[casino]]'s brightly lit machines, laughing in delight when<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" /> she<ref name="Bucket's List Voxx Vortex" /> won.<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" />

==Behind the scenes==
A casino gambler who was a member of the species first appeared in "[[The Voxx Vortex 5000]],"<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" /> the ninth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series, which premiered on [[December 1]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Luke Harrington]] created concept art illustrations of the gambler dated to [[March 14]], [[March 16]],<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|subdomain=illustrium|url=projects/ZGJkPZ|text=Star Wars Resistance|username=illustrium|name=[[Luke Harrington]]|date=2020-10-23|quote=A few characters I designed for Lucasfilm's Star Wars Resistance show on Disney XD.}}</ref> and [[March 20]] of [[2018]].<ref name="Art">{{SW|url=the-voxx-vortex-5000-concept-art-gallery|text="The Voxx Vortex 5000" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}}</ref> One of Harrington's works included several different head designs for the gambler, as well as three alternate designs done in full color.<ref name="ArtStation" />
